parameters.name: DBNodeClass
parameters.description: The specifications of the node. For more information, see [Specifications of compute nodes](~~102542~~).

parameters.name: DBType
parameters.description:
The type of the database engine. Valid values:

- **MySQL**

- **PostgreSQL**

- **Oracle**

parameters.name: DBVersion
parameters.description:
The version of the database engine.
Valid values for MySQL:

- **5.6**

- **5.7**

- **8.0**

Valid values for PostgreSQL:

- **11**

- **14**

Valid values for Oracle:

- **11**

- **14**

> This parameter is required when the **DBType** parameter is specified.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go (also known as postpaid or hourly billing).

- **Prepaid**: subscription (also known as prepaid).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID. The default value is **cn-hangzhou**.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query the available regions.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone ID.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query the available zones.
